row.title: Graph step must not SELECT tables core drops by name
row.body: What Works' live beat logged '_cf_KV: access prohibited' because the datagraph step read every D1 table before core/datagraph dropped secret-shaped and platform ones. Filter by SKIP_TABLE before reading (pass the table on empty so it is still reported as dropped). Several parallel sessions also built DATAGRAPH-1 at once (#2151, #2157, #2158, #2166): check open PRs for the same directive before starting.
